QuestInfo.name: Towards the Sky 1
QuestInfo.0: In order to chase the Dragon Rider, you're going to need to learn to fly... Discover the secret to flight from Matada, the Halflinger Adventurer.
QuestInfo.1: Bring Matada the items he needs so that he can teach you how to fly.
QuestInfo.2: You brought #bMatada#k the items that he wanted.
QuestInfo.rewardSummary: EXP 383,306\nCan proceed to the 'Towards the Sky 2' quest\n

0.0: To pursue the Dragon Rider, you'll have to enter through the <Crimson Sky Doorway> to the Crimson Sky area where the Dragons live . To do that, you'll have know how to fly...\r\n#L0##bFly? Like, flap flap flap my arms? In the sky?#l\n#k
0.1: Yes. Normally, flying is impossible for humans.\r\n#L0##bNo kidding. So is all hope lost, then?#l\n#k
0.2: Well... There is a way. Many years ago, I came across a recipe for a potion that supposedly allows humans to fly. Ancient documents also contain records of humans that were able to fly.\r\n#L0##bI knew there had to be a way! So what do I need to do?#l\n#k
0.3: I can teach you the secret of flying if you bring me a few ingredients. You need to bring me #b40 #t04000226:#, 40 #t04000236:#, 1 #t2020015:#, and 10 #t4001402:##k.

yes.0: Please bring me the ingredients that I mentioned.

no.0: Well, you can't go after the #bDragon Rider#k if you can't fly.

1.0: Have you brought all the ingredients I need?

yes.0: Aha, looks like you've got it all. Please give me a moment to mix these together.

item.0: Looks like you're still missing a few things. Please bring me all of the ingredients. They can all be found from monsters in Minar Forest...it shouldn't be too hard.
